law_record.title: Vehicles, bicycles, electric bicycles, electric scooters and pedestrians (2)(a)
law_record.text: When overtaking or passing a bicycle, an electric bicycle or an electric scooter proceeding in the same direction, the driver of a motor vehicle shall exercise due care and: If there is more than one lane for traffic proceeding in the same direction, move the vehicle to the lane to the immediate left, if the lane is available and moving into the lane is reasonably safe.

activation_conditions: the subject overtakes or passes a bicycle, electric bicycle or electric scooter going the same way
there is more than one lane for traffic in that direction
the lane to the immediate left is available
exceptions: the lane to the immediate left is not available, or moving into it would not be reasonably safe
residue: 'due care' and 'reasonably safe' are judgement elements needing declared bounds
summary.subject: driver

timing_requirements.requirement: the lane change precedes the abreast phase — the subject must already be in the left lane when it passes
the left lane is held for the whole of the pass
